lane: lane/a-catacomb-icons (2026-11-18): the Unmarked Catacombs' 20 item icons, in place of the twin drawings they wore since lane/c-catacombs (tests/pixel-icons.mjs KNOWN_TWINS). The Coordinator generated and chose them; PixelLab subscription gens only (credits $0 throughout)
items: the eight wing keys (src/data/chests.js CATACOMB_KEYS: waterlogged_key_bronze silver gold platinum, bone_key_bronze silver gold platinum) and the twelve Bronze and Silver pieces (src/data/catacomb-armor.js CATACOMB_ARMOR_SHIPPED: tinkers_kettle ratters_hood midwifes_hat hodmans_boots tanners_boots washerwomans_slippers, cranemans_helm fletchers_hood bakers_cap dockhands_boots sewermans_boots fishwifes_slippers), each drawn from its row's name and line
tool: create_1_direction_object, view top-down, palette hr-world-56-v2 (all 56), 64 candidates a call on a 30 px canvas (10 gens), item_descriptions in slot order
finish: tools/world-art/import-catacomb-icons-2026-11-18.mjs, by import-drop-icons-2026-11-17.mjs iconOf: the 30x30 pick centred on 32x32, the outline closed in #0b0a0c, palette and alpha checked. picks/<id>.png are the raw candidates as PixelLab returned them; fill is the larger side of the pick's bounding box over the 32 px cell
look: each wing has one look up its four tiers, the metal changing under it: the Waterlogged keys verdigris, waterweed and a drip; the Bone keys a bone bow growing into a skull (knucklebone, crossed bones, skull, glowing skull)

read: art/review/catacomb-icons/final-20.png (the Coordinator's preview of all 20); lane/a-catacomb-icons read them in the real bag (tools/qa/local-world.mjs, a new local hero, real pocketHtml and CSS, a list of its own beside the bag's) at 1440x900 (44 px pockets) and 922x423 (36 px), the icon at 32 px, each wing's keys under the Tower keys, each piece under its standard twin. All 20 read as their kind; weakest: bone_key_silver (thin, the crossed bones read as a plain cross), fletchers_hood and sewermans_boots (the darkest on the slot; the arrows and the slime are what carry them), hodmans_boots beside dockhands_boots (one dark plate boot, the rope the only difference) and washerwomans_slippers beside fishwifes_slippers (one fur-lined slipper in blue and in red)
